evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 澹泊宁静
evidence.excerpt_zh: 日天琳宇迤東稍南稻田彌望河水周環中有田字式殿凡四門其東北面皆有樓北樓正宇為澹泊寧静東為曙光樓殿之東門外為翠扶樓西門外別垣内宇為多稼軒南向七楹其東臨稻畦者前為觀稼軒後為怡情悦目為稻香亭又東稍北為溪山不盡為蘭溪隱玉多稼軒西池南為水精域西偏為静香屋為招鶴磴池後東北為寸碧西北為引勝正北為互妙樓（圓明園冊）臣等謹按澹泊寧静四十景之一額為皇上御書南門額曰亦復佳西門額曰得山水趣北廊後額曰麥雨稻風與曙光樓額皆御書多稼軒觀稼軒怡情悅目稻香亭溪山不盡蘭溪隱玉諸額皆世宗御書多稼軒聨曰風裊爐烟移晝漏月臨書幌正宵衣又曰厥惟艱哉載芟載柞籌穡事亦既勤止曰暘曰雨驗農時皆皇上御書
evidence.summary: Rice fields ringed by water, with a hall on a 田 plan of four gates at the centre: 澹泊寧静. Around it 曙光樓, 翠扶樓, and a western court with the seven-bay 多稼軒, 觀稼軒, 怡情悦目, 稻香亭, 溪山不盡, 蘭溪隱玉, 水精域, 静香屋, 招鶴磴, 寸碧, 引勝 and 互妙樓.

evidence.title: 圆明园遗址考古有重大发现, 中国日报网
evidence.summary: First season of 2020, about 500 m2: 9 rooms located, with steps, pegs, kerb stones and drains; first use of plant archaeology in the garden. Scene about 140 x 160 m, 26,000 m2, 1,350 m2 of buildings. The excavators say the basic data agree with the documents (rooms 4.48 m, eaves columns 3.68 m).

evidence.title: 澹泊宁静 三期发掘, 中新网 徐婧
evidence.summary: Three seasons from 2020 exposed the whole base of the 田字房 hall: 33 rooms each 4.48 m square, gallery 1.28 m, base standing about 0.55 m, with column bases, floor bricks, drains, steps and pebble aprons. Base, courtyards and paths show heavy burning, which the archaeologists link to the 1860 fire. Paddy of the imperial rice fields was also found.

evidence.title: 澹泊宁静遗址发掘获重要成果, 光明日报 via 中新网
evidence.summary: The 2022 season opened six rooms and the south-west courtyard of 田字房. Floor bricks 40 cm square; courtyards in blue stone slabs; a trench shows nine rammed layers over cedar pegs; a brick drain with sticky-rice mortar was built in with the wall footings. Almost all surviving bricks and slabs are cracked and reddened by fire.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
